name: Royal Gold Purse (100k)
description: A heavy velvet purse of gold coins stamped with the Crownspire coat of arms. Instantly adds 100,000 Gold.

name: Sovereign Gold Chest (1M)
description: An imperial gold chest containing 1,000,000 pure gold coins. Instantly adds 1,000,000 Gold.

name: Citadel Grain Supply (500k)
description: Enchanted bags of preservation-spell grains. Adds 500,000 Food to sustain your city.

name: Ironwood Timber Bundle (500k)
description: A shipment of high-density ironwood, vital for fortifying city gates and defenses. Adds 500,000 Wood.

name: Quarried Granite Block (250k)
description: Heavy quarried granite block, ready for construction. Adds 250,000 Stone.

name: Refined Alchemical Ore (100k)
description: High-purity refined alchemical iron ore, perfect for forging. Adds 100,000 Iron.

name: Minor Health Elixir
description: A faint red alchemical brew that heals basic combat wounds. Restores 1,000 Hero HP.

name: Astral Stamina Potion
description: A starry blue fluid that reinvigorates generals. Instantly restores 100 Campaign Stamina.

name: Temporal Sand (15m)
description: A small hourglass containing enchanted sands. Reduces any active construction or research queue by 15 minutes.

name: Chronos Quartz (1h)
description: A crystalline quartz humming with time magic. Reduces any active queue by 1 hour.

name: Temporal Singularity (8h)
description: An intense, dark vortex of localized time. Speeds up work queues by 8 hours.

name: Sovereign Battle Banner (+10% ATK)
description: A banner soaked in martial glory. Boosts your legion's combat ATK stats by +10% for 12 hours.

name: Aegis Dome Shield (8h)
description: Projects a shimmering magic field over your city, shielding it from enemy attacks and recon for 8 hours.

name: Sovereign Ward (24h)
description: A golden ward that immunizes your city from all attacks, scouts, and sieges for 24 hours.

name: Quarry Wooden Chest
description: A simple wooden chest discarded by local wildlings. Open to reveal standard construction items and raw gold.

name: Gilded Sovereign Treasure
description: An ornate, heavy gold-banded imperial chest with dragon seals. Open to receive legendary materials, hero shards, and immense gold.

name: Valerius Sovereign Shard
description: An absolute essence shard of Valerius, the Dragon Sentinel. Used to evolve his star rank and unlock devastating powers.

name: Aria Obsidian Shard
description: An obsidian soul crystal containing the assassin Aria's shadow essence. Used for her Ascension.

name: Tactician Tome of Wisdom
description: An ancient alchemical codex filled with tactical history. Use to grant 1,000 XP to any General.

name: Grand Archon Elixir (5k XP)
description: A highly concentrated glowing alchemical formula. Use to grant 5,000 XP directly to a selected General.

name: Sunfire Dragon-Glass Blade
description: A massive broadsword forged with obsidian dragon-glass and tempered in caldera lava. Level: 40, Type: Weapon.

name: Celestial Star Sigil
description: An astral sigil required for advancing any Sovereign General beyond the 4-Star threshold.

name: Unstable Warp Stone
description: A crackling alchemical rune stone. Instantly teleports your citadel to a completely random coordinate on the World Map.

name: Precision Gateway Core
description: A massive mechanical waypoint key. Teleports your city to any precise, unoccupied coordinate on the World Map.

name: Aurora Castle Citadel Skin
description: Transforms your standard medieval citadel into a dazzling crystalline fortress of northern light magic. (Permanent Skin)
